title: Importing a mod replaces the installed one by UUID even when it is older
notes: AddImportedMod swaps by UUID with no version check (MainWindowViewModel.cs:3172-3192). All three import paths call it (:1853, :3323, :3451). Refresh keeps the highest VersionInt (DivinityModDataLoader.cs:787-805). When file names match, the newer pak on disk is overwritten, so the downgrade is real.
fixCaveats: Compare versions and confirm before a downgrade. Check before overwriting a same-named pak. Use Version.VersionInt, as refresh does, not Version64.

title: One unparseable entry in modsettings.lsx reads as a total reset
notes: Parse failures are swallowed and return null, which gives empty ActiveMods (DivinityModDataLoader.cs:838-847, 963-978). LSLib new Guid(str) throws on one bad UUID (NodeAttribute.cs:440-448). Both reset detectors (MainWindowViewModel.cs:2287-2298, 5426-5440) then report an external reset and never mention a read error.
fixCaveats: Return a parse-failed flag and the exception, and skip the restore offer. Change the catch inside the overload too. Treat the profile loader (DMDL:931) the same way, and stop the startup Yes from overwriting silently.

title: Saving an order truncates the JSON file in place
notes: FileMode.Create plus a single WriteAsync, with no temp file or rename (DivinityModDataLoader.cs:1098-1113; sync twin 1080-1096). Ctrl+S reaches it (MainWindowViewModel.cs:2597-2633, 4969). A crash or full disk leaves an empty or partial file, and the order then drops silently from the list (DMDL:1115-1145). Unlikely but real.
fixCaveats: Write to .tmp, Flush(true), then File.Replace (or File.Move with overwrite). Apply the same to the sync twin and probably ExportLoadOrderAsync.

title: Duplicate mods with equal versions pick a random winner, and the loser is offered for deletion
notes: ConcurrentBag plus a strict > on VersionInt makes the winner of a tie nondeterministic (DivinityModDataLoader.cs:773-806). Losers go to DeleteMods(...,true) with entries pre-selected (MainWindowViewModel.cs:1702-1708, 4359-4370; ModFileDeletionData.cs:13-20). Ties are common. The user must still confirm.
fixCaveats: Tie-break on newest LastWriteTime, then ordinal path, and maybe don't pre-select on a tie. The dialog already shows the kept path. It lacks dates and sizes.

title: Dropping into a column-sorted active list inserts at the view index, not the load-order index
docRef: AUDIT-PLAN claim 23 and Stage 5 step 5 note
notes: A header click sorts the ActiveMods view (.xaml.cs:752-769). gong remaps the index only when the counts differ (dl-gong/DropInfo.cs:55-80), so a sorted drop inserts at the view index (ModListDropHandler.cs:133, 150-162, 188-191). DragOver doesn't block it (:79-88), and the change is silent. This contradicts AUDIT-PLAN.
fixCaveats: Map the target item to its ActiveMods index, including in the same-list adjustment, or block drops or turn off sorting while sorted by anything other than '#'. The original paths lacked the src/ prefix.

title: `@desc` and `@file` filters can throw on mods with no description or no file path
notes: Refuted. ValueContains lacks a null guard, but listed mods never have a null Description or FileName. ParseMetaFile falls back to "", and override paks set Description. Both loaders set FilePath (DivinityModDataLoader.cs:73-80, 211, 230, 364, 618, 641; DivinityModData.cs:383, 514-517). Base-game mods are kept out by CanAddToLoadOrder (MainWindowViewModel.cs:2142-2144, 5243). The voter suggested Low.
fixCaveats: A null/empty guard is a cheap safeguard worth bundling with perf/filter work. It fixes no bug users can hit.

title: Archive import flattens paks, so same-name paks overwrite each other (I5)
docRef: plan Stage 3 I5; AUDIT-PLAN claim 13, AUDIT-PLAN-04
notes: GetFileName plus File.Create truncates with no collision check (MainWindowViewModel.cs:3423-3429). Mods are added with no duplicate-path check (:3443-3453), so the first mod stays listed as a stale entry. Low because the manager's flat exports can't contain duplicate names. Only unusual third-party archives can.
fixCaveats: Track the output names written during the import and warn on a repeat, or keep the subfolder path in the name. The uuid/version layout only helps archives the manager exported itself.

title: The Script Extender updater writes DWrite.dll in place, so cancel or failure leaves it truncated (B12)
location: MWVM:341-366; the game-running check is commented out at MWVM:5424-5425
docRef: CLAUDE.md section 3 and section 7; AUDIT-CLAUDE 9.2 / item 11
notes: Corrected: the write is in place with no temp file (MainWindowViewModel.cs:362-363), but ZipArchive buffers the HTTP stream first (:352, :356), so a network drop can't truncate the file. Only a cancel or a decompression failure during a very short copy from memory can, and that shows an error (:396). Lines 5424-5425 are the modsettings watcher, not the updater.
fixCaveats: The fix is cheap: write to .part, then File.Move with overwrite. A game-running check adds little, since a loaded DLL would block File.Create anyway.

title: LastExported is shared by all profiles, so the startup "restore" offers another profile's order
notes: Corrected: there is one LastExported.json with no profile key (MainWindowViewModel.cs:2852-2858), exported into SelectedProfile unchecked (:2283-2327, :2553). Loads force the Public profile first (:2425-2428; DivinityModDataLoader.cs:901-928), so cross-profile misuse needs a profile set with no profile named Public.
fixCaveats: Store the profile UUID in the backup and compare it before prompting. Bundle with §6.4. Not Medium on its own.
